fyi, the test cases where I was hitting this were:
- `blockchain_tests/for_amsterdam_at_0030M/compute/instruction/storage/storage_access_cold.json`
- `blockchain_tests/for_amsterdam_at_0030M/compute/instruction/system/selfdestruct_created.json`
- `blockchain_tests/for_amsterdam_at_0030M/compute/eip7928_block_level_access_lists/block_access_list/deploy_then_interact.json`
 
Probably because geth doesn't check if code was deployed in block when adding code accesses: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/c9a2bc73c847319a8faa57de59e42c0efc420682/core/state/statedb.go#L378-L398

But I didn't look into it further than just checking getCode/getCodeSize, so it would need to be further verified.
